issues.where: the lava fall pouring from the cave mouth down the cliff
issues.what: the fall reads as flat, evenly bright orange strands that shift like an animated texture; it has no thickness, no slowing, no crusting skin, and the dark cave above stays a dead flat patch over 7 seconds
issues.fix: simulate the fall as a thick, slow fluid with a cooling dark skin that folds and tears, varied speed along the channel, and glow that lights the cave lip and the fume

issues.where: the lava strands and glowing blocks on the cliff face, frames 4006 to 4017
issues.what: the bright shapes in the fall change outline from one frame to the next with no coherent flow direction, so the fall boils and shimmers instead of moving downhill
issues.fix: make the lava motion temporally coherent (advected, not re-noised per frame) and filter fine glow detail so it does not crawl

issues.where: the large creature in the centre over 7 seconds
issues.what: the near creature holds the same pose for the whole shot except its head; body, legs and weight never shift, so it reads as a posed model beside the only moving part
issues.fix: give it breathing, weight shifts between legs, a step or turn, and small secondary motion in the hanging fronds

issues.where: the herd of creatures across the lava plain and the lava flows
issues.what: the camera slides across the plain while the creatures and the lava channels stay essentially unchanged; the place reads as a still picture being tracked across, with only the plume drifting
issues.fix: animate the distant herd walking out of step, let the lava channels creep and crust, and let the surface pools flare and dim irregularly

issues.where: the lava channel in the foreground and the push in toward it
issues.what: the crust carries regular swirling stripe patterns that look like a texture map rather than folded ropy skin, and the move pushes in to end on a frame filled by this patterned surface and a vague orange glow blob at left
issues.fix: replace the striped crust with sculpted ropy pahoehoe folds that buckle as the channel moves, and end the push on a composed picture with a clear subject

issues.where: the whole shot, the arch, plain and distant creatures
issues.what: over almost 4 seconds nearly nothing changes; only the plume drifts slightly and the camera barely moves, so the shot reads as a held still
issues.fix: add life to the frame: creatures moving in the distance, lava flickering and creeping at the plain edge, heat haze and fume from the vents

issues.where: the glowing fan-shaped plant the creature feeds from
issues.what: its glow and puff of vapour pulse evenly rather than reacting to the creature, and the vapour fills in as a soft overlay
issues.fix: tie the vapour bursts to the creature's contact and let them rise and disperse with varied rhythm

issues.where: the stripe patterns on the lava crust, frames 3477 to 3488
issues.what: the fine stripe detail on the crust swims slightly from frame to frame as the camera moves
issues.fix: stabilise the crust texture to the surface and add mip filtering to stop crawling

issues.where: the steam vent on the left slope, frames 2722 to 2733
issues.what: the small steam puff shifts and jitters slightly between consecutive frames rather than rising smoothly
issues.fix: smooth the vapour simulation so it rises and thins continuously
